decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C590-09 (radio and CMMS agree), repair likely 13:30. That stope holds 256 t at 16.5 g/t, the richest ore. LH-10 comes out of preventive maintenance at 10:00 and is idle, so using it costs no production at another place. Travel is 0.33 h, so it arrives about 10:20 and loads about 30 t/h, roughly 186 t (about 99 oz) by 17:00. Central trucks are near their limit (91 t/h against 110 t/h inflow), so the haul gain is capped. I estimate only about 30 oz because high-grade ore displaces lower-grade ore in the haul mix. I did not take loaders from producing stopes or from development headings, because that would lose more than it gains. No reserve is activated, since no stope is stopped.

decision_cruda.rationale: Central is truck-limited (inflow 110 vs 91 t/h), so no loader goes to C590-09 even at 16.5 g/t. Este has truck room (72 t/h vs 24 inflow) and E543-07 holds 300 t at 8.3 g/t, about 6.8 oz/h per LH410. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading (0.4 oz/h) and arrives about 10:00. LH-10 leaves PM at 10:00 and arrives about 10:30. Both together clear the 300 t (about 80 oz) by 17:00. The cost is about 3 oz of development. LH-03 repair is likely 13:40, too late to matter. LH-09 stays on the critical-path heading at 5.7 oz/h.
